glosses: remaining (which remains after something has been removed)

examples.text: Onde está o restante do dinheiro?
examples.en: Where's the rest of the money?

examples.text: O que aconteceu com o restante da comida?
examples.en: What happened to the rest of the food?

examples.text: Ainda estamos analisando os dados restantes.
examples.en: We're still analyzing the remaining data.

examples.text: Havia pouco açúcar restante no pote.
examples.en: There was little sugar left in the pot.
We have isolated one patient from the rest.
